description: Frozen settings of the trained system, as used for the final evaluation. src/demo.py reads the decision thresholds and the speaker threshold from this file; the other entries document the front end and must equal the constants in src/p1v4_feats.py and src/p1v4_l1.py (src/demo.py checks this).

ours.what: step 2d read-out (readouts_2d.npz) on the fine-tuned VoxTurn

original_readout.what: the fine-tuned VoxTurn's own option head (new_head in l1_new.pt)

decision_thresholds.rule: decide stop when P(stop) >= stop, respond when P(respond) >= respond (src/p1v4_score.py decide). Both pairs were chosen on the development set by src/p1v4_score.py operating_point and frozen before the test set was opened.

speaker_id.rule: a speech segment is tagged 'user' when the cosine between its ECAPA-TDNN embedding and the user's enrolment embedding is at least the threshold, else 'other' (not the user)
speaker_id.threshold_choice: maximum balanced accuracy (mean of the user and not-the-user recalls) over the 4,235 unique development-set speech segments (src/p1v4_context.py threshold); balanced accuracy 0.937 there
speaker_id.enrolment: the user's voice reads a fixed two-sentence passage once (about 8 to 14 s depending on the voice; speaker_enrolment.json); its ECAPA-TDNN embedding is the reference

transcripts.decoding: greedy, language en, task transcribe, at most 160 new tokens
transcripts.segments: every speech segment that started before the decision point, cut at its scripted times: a finished segment from its start to 0.2 s after its end (at most to the decision point), a segment still going at the decision point up to that point; each cut is padded to 30 s

detector.architecture: PANNs Cnn14_DecisionLevelAtt, whole network fine-tuned, new attention head
detector.input: audio from the start of the scene to the decision point, 16 kHz upsampled to 32 kHz
detector.output: per class, runs of frames with probability >= 0.2, runs closer than 0.3 s merged: (class, start, end, peak probability)
detector.choice: epoch 3 of 3, chosen by window-level macro F1 over the seven classes on the development set (0.876)

adapter.name: p1v4
adapter.target_modules: all-linear layers of the language model

decision_model.questions: phrasing 0 of the stop and respond questions in src/p1v4_l1.py, both asked in one pass when both apply
decision_model.marker: 'agent' when the assistant is talking at the decision point, else 'user'
